instruction: Three-Room Service Hut. On this machine, open Archicad 27 from its desktop shortcut before loading the supplied model. Start from a blank Archicad project with no init files or reference images. Build or edit the model using real Archicad BIM elements such as Walls, Slabs, Zones, Doors, Windows, Roofs, and Stairs where required; use real BIM elements rather than visual-only detail geometry where the task requires model elements. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using Archicad's built-in IFC export or Save As IFC workflow. Export the complete model as IFC4 and include the Zones/Spaces in the export. Model a compact single-storey service hut about 9 m by 5 m with three Zones named OFFICE, STORAGE, and WC. Include exterior walls, internal partitions, one floor slab, at least three doors, and at least two windows. The exported IFC should contain Zones exported as IfcSpace entries named OFFICE, STORAGE, WC. It should contain at least 1 building storey, at least 3 IfcSpace zones, at least 6 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase elements, at least 1 IfcSlab element, at least 3 IfcDoor elements, at least 2 IfcWindow elements. The shaped model should have an overall size roughly matching X span 9 m, Y span 5 m, and Z span 3 m. The IFC should have unique GlobalId values for IfcRoot objects. Other exact coordinates, room proportions, wall thicknesses, opening positions, materials, library part names, property sets, layers, relationship nesting, and harmless exporter metadata may vary as long as the saved result.ifc satisfies the stated BIM content.
